name: 2017 OF201
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter its discoverers estimate for an assumed albedo of 0.13; not measured.
credit: Cheng, Li & Yang (2026), The Astrophysical Journal Letters 998, 6: diameter about 700 km for an assumed albedo of 0.13
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere 700 km across, the diameter Cheng, Li & Yang estimate from its brightness for an assumed albedo of 0.13. The size is not measured.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: 2017 OF201 never comes closer to the Sun than about 45 au, and its orbit reaches about 1,600 au. It was reported in 2025 from 24 observations spread over 20 years.
card: Reported in 2025; its orbit reaches about 1,600 au from the Sun.
datasetSummary: A sphere 700 km across, the size its discoverers estimate for an assumed albedo.
